package.name: robot_drive_status_broadcaster
package.description: Whole-body MyActuator drive telemetry broadcaster. Claims TxPDO 0x1A02 state interfaces (motor_temperature, drive_temperature, bus_voltage, error_code) for every configured joint and republishes each signal as a std_msgs/Float64MultiArray sized to the joint roster. Consumed by robot_safety_supervisor for thermal Kp derating and over-temp / under-voltage breach detection.
